title: Overture
description: Instrumental introduction to an opera, ballet, or oratorio
extract: An overture is an instrumental piece of music that is written to introduce a dramatic work such as a ballet, opera, or oratorio. During the early Romantic era, composers such as Beethoven and Mendelssohn composed overtures which were independent, self-existing, instrumental, programmatic works that foreshadowed genres such as the symphonic poem. These were "at first undoubtedly intended to be played at the head of a programme".
